card.name: Verb just before "used" in equipment instructions
card.fires_on: The small word (was, is, to, if, comma) right after a device, diluent or method noun, where the next word is expected to be "use" or "used". Seen in preparation and administration directions for syringes, pumps, bags and diluents.

modes.label: was/is before used
modes.description: The verb after an equipment or diluent noun in an "if X was used" clause.

modes.label: to/comma before use
modes.description: A linking word or comma that leads into the word "use" in dosing directions.
modes.example: Provide instructions regarding which syringe<< to>> use and how to administer the specified dose

card.writes: It suppresses "use" and "uses" in several languages, so the model does not repeat "use" and picks another continuation.
card.plain: It fires in preparation directions just before the word "used" or "use", as in "if a syringe pump was used".
